title: Customer Preference
description: Persisted lodging and program preferences for the authenticated customer.

stay.description: Stay-time accommodation preferences in priority order.

description.description: Human-readable label for `id` when the Platform does not recognize the identifier (for example `King bed` for `king_bed`).

priority.description: 1-based priority; lower numbers are higher priority.

earn.description: How the customer prefers to accrue loyalty value from qualifying stays.

kind.description: Accrual destination for qualifying stays. Well-known values: `program_currency`, `partner`. When `kind` is `partner`, `program_id` MUST identify the partner program and the preferred link SHOULD appear with `preferred: true` under `loyalty[hotel_program].partner_memberships`. Unknown values MUST be tolerated.

program_id.description: Reverse-domain identifier of the partner loyalty program where the guest prefers to earn when `kind` is `partner` (for example `com.aa.aadvantage`). MUST match `program_id` on the preferred `partner_memberships` entry. Omitted when earning into the hotel program currency.
